title: Pharmacological investigation of genistein for its therapeutic potential against nitroglycerin-induced migraine headache.
authors: Sajjad, Qirrat; Khan, Arif-Ullah; Khan, Aslam
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨金雀异黄酮对硝酸甘油诱导偏头痛的治疗作用，涉及炎症和氧化应激通路，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Migraine, typically occurs on one side of the head, lasts for hours to days. Trigemino-vascular system (TVS) plays a vital role in pain generation, with neurogenic inflammation and oxidative stress playing key roles in its pathophysiology. METHODS: This study aimed to investigate genistein's potential as anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant agent in mitigating migraine pain. Genistein (20 and 50 mg/kg) was administered intraperitoneally (IP) to nitroglycerin (NTG; 10 mg/kg)-induced migraine model in rats. Behavioral analysis, antioxidant assay, immunohistochemistry (IHC), histopathological examination, ELISA, and RT-PCR were conducted to evaluate the antimigraine potential of genistein. KEY FINDINGS: In-silico analysis showed genestien's ACE values of -4.8 to -9.2 Kcal/mol against selected protein targets. Genistein significantly reversed mechanical and thermal nociception, light phobicity, and head scratching; increased the intensities of GST, GSH, catalase; and down regulated lipid peroxidase (LPO) in cortex and trigeminal nucleus caudalis (TNC). It also reduced Nrf2, NF-kB, and IL6 expression, analyzed through IHC, improved histopathological features, and increased COX-2 and decreased PPAR-gamma expressions, while RT-PCR analysis revealed increased PPAR-gamma expressions in genistein-treated rats. CONCLUSION: Genistein exhibited potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties in migraine treatment, acting through multifactorial mechanisms by modulating the expression of numerous proteins in the region cortex and TNC.
abstract_zh: 目的：偏头痛通常表现为单侧头痛，持续数小时至数天。三叉神经血管系统（TVS）在疼痛产生中发挥关键作用，其中神经源性炎症和氧化应激在其病理生理过程中起核心作用。方法：本研究旨在探讨染料木黄酮作为抗炎和抗氧化剂在缓解偏头痛疼痛中的潜力。将染料木黄酮（20和50 mg/kg）腹腔注射（IP）至硝酸甘油（NTG；10 mg/kg）诱导的大鼠偏头痛模型中。通过行为学分析、抗氧化测定、免疫组织化学（IHC）、组织病理学检查、ELISA和RT-PCR评估染料木黄酮的抗偏头痛潜力。主要发现：计算机模拟分析显示，染料木黄酮对选定蛋白靶标的ACE值为-4.8至-9.2 Kcal/mol。染料木黄酮显著逆转了机械性和热性伤害感受、畏光及头部抓挠；增加了皮层和三叉神经尾核（TNC）中GST、GSH、过氧化氢酶的强度；并下调了脂质过氧化物酶（LPO）。它还通过IHC分析降低了Nrf2、NF-kB和IL6的表达，改善了组织病理学特征，并增加了COX-2和降低了PPAR-γ表达，而RT-PCR分析显示染料木黄酮处理的大鼠中PPAR-γ表达增加。结论：染料木黄酮在偏头痛治疗中表现出强效的抗氧化和抗炎特性，通过调节皮层和TNC区域多种蛋白的表达，发挥多因素机制作用。
